title: Anahat Singh Advances to Qatar Classic Round of 16
indian_angle: Indian squash player Anahat Singh secured her spot in the Round of 16 at the Qatar Classic.
summary: Anahat Singh progressed to the Round of 16 at the Qatar Classic, where she is set to face top seed Tinne Gilis.

title: Harleen Deol Unfazed by India Snub, Focuses on W-CPL Stint
indian_angle: Indian cricketer Harleen Deol shared her thoughts on being excluded from national selections, emphasizing her focus on the Women's CPL.
summary: Despite recent national team exclusions, Harleen Deol remains positive, concentrating on her performance in the Women's CPL.

title: Ajith Kumar Finishes 38th at Silverstone Le Mans Cup, CM Vijay Flags Off
indian_angle: Indian actor-racer Ajith Kumar competed at the Silverstone Le Mans Cup, with Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay flagging off the event.
summary: Ajith Kumar completed the Silverstone Le Mans Cup race in 38th position, three laps behind the winner, in an event flagged off by Tamil Nadu CM C Joseph Vijay.

title: Full-Strength India Aims to Flex Muscle Against Afghanistan in 1st T20I
indian_angle: India's full-strength cricket team is set to face Afghanistan in the first T20I, preparing for the upcoming Asian Games.
summary: India, featuring players like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and returning Jasprit Bumrah, is poised to start their three-match T20I series against Afghanistan as clear favorites.

title: Chaminda Vaas Joins Delhi Capitals as Bowling Coach, Amit Mishra Also On Board
indian_angle: IPL franchise Delhi Capitals has appointed Chaminda Vaas as fast bowling coach and Indian spinner Amit Mishra as spin-bowling coach.
summary: Delhi Capitals strengthens its coaching staff with the addition of Sri Lankan Chaminda Vaas and Indian veteran Amit Mishra for the upcoming IPL season.
